vectors.name: error_response_user_declined
vectors.description: Error response to a Signing request: MSG_TYPE 0xc4 is response, error, TYPE 0x04. ERROR is 0x01 (user declined) and ERROR_MESSAGE is "signing was declined" padded with 0x00 up to 32 bytes.

vectors.name: error_response_vendor
vectors.description: Error response to a Signing request with the vendor code 0xff, where the meaning is only in ERROR_MESSAGE, here "device is locked".

vectors.name: error_response_reserved_code
vectors.description: Error response to a Get Xpubs request with ERROR 0x0c, taken from the range reserved for future standard codes. A version 1 parser does not know it and must still accept the message and fall back to ERROR_MESSAGE.
